comment: detect.c trap_detect() monster-carried chest arm (1053-1055) and trapped_chest_at() monster checks (172-176). Dlvl 1 of seed 8812004 has no floor traps (port scan of 8812001-8812800). A debug Wizard takes off her cloak, drops everything (including her scrolls of scare monster), steps away, wishes for a trapped large box and creates a water nymph, which steals the box and teleports away. Confused by a potion of confusion, she reads a scroll of gold detection: trap_detect() finds the trap in the nymph's inventory away from her and shows the trap map, where '^' moves the cursor to the trapped-chest symbol and autodescribe's trapped_chest_at() finds the box in the nymph's inventory (172-175). After a few turns the nymph has moved; farlook on the remembered trap symbol reaches trapped_chest_at()'s final FALSE (176).
